sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 26 (no cell comments); 'Deterministic Checks' C28 for context
evidence: All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (visual: 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), line 1 of gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish and scored/visual prompt.md, matching the frozen template openings; every judge.toml wires the playwright MCP server (playwright-mcp --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium), which tests/Dockerfile:19-38 installs (@playwright/mcp@0.0.79 + chromium symlink), and test.sh:197-200 substitutes {app_context} (URL http://localhost:3000) into every prompt. Source/memory scoring is excluded in the text: render 'Use only rendered browser behavior' (l.2), constraints 'Use browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only' (l.2), functional 'browser-visible product behavior', 'passes only on evidence you gathered in this session', 'Never use curl or shell commands', 'never pass a criterion on a general impression' (l.2, 23-28, 46-47, 54), polish 'Judge the rendered product and interactions, not code style' (l.4) and 'Score each criterion independently from browser-visible evidence' (l.22), visual 'Score each criterion independently from rendered evidence' (l.40); all prompts treat submitted source as untrusted. First-paint guesses are excluded: render criterion requires wrong-password rejection plus Gwen's sign-in; constraints gate requires a post, reload and second-context readback by harriet; scored prompts' gate says 'a first-paint imitation does not pass' and rejects static mocks/seeded-looking facades (functional l.15-18, polish l.14-17, visual l.22-25). Every criterion description names interactive browser steps (e.g. polish enter_sends Shift+Enter/Enter, delete_confirm decline/confirm/reload, refusal_in_place 10s wait; visual criteria name thread/transcript/390x844 views). Adversarial: a static mock with hard-coded seed text fails render/constraints (no persisted post or cross-context readback); a conforming SPA/alternative route layout is not penalised because prompts forbid guessed routes and match controls by intent. Only residual: isolated=false (template default) lets the claude-code judge see the filesystem, but no prompt invites source reading and the text restricts evidence to the browser. No configured judge transcript exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says the full grading run is absent), so actual judge tool use is NOT EXERCISED; that is a runtime/workload-row gap, not a prompt defect for this row.
